definition: [ הִלּוּל ] noun [masculine] (Late Hebrew id. ) only plural הִלּוּלִים rejoicing, praise : 1. וִיַּעֲשׂוּ הִלּוּלִים Judg 9:27 i.e. a vintage-rejoicing, merry-making, connected with thanksgiving וַיָּבאֹוּ בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם etc. (i.e. god baal-Berith, see v Judg 9:4 ). 2. of praise to ׳ י , ׳ פקדֶשׁ ה Lev 19:24 ( H ) holiness of praise , i.e. a consecrated thing in token of thanksgiving for fruit, offered in 4th year (compare Late Hebrew).

BDB2171 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB2173

[הִלּוּל] noun [masculine] (Late Hebrew id.) only plural הִלּוּלִים rejoicing, praise:

1. וִיַּעֲשׂוּ הִלּוּלִים Judg 9:27 i.e. a vintage-rejoicing, merry-making, connected with thanksgiving וַיָּבאֹוּ בֵּית אֱלֹהֵיהֶם etc. (i.e. god baal-Berith, see vJudg 9:4).
2. of praise to ׳י, ׳פקדֶשׁ ה Lev 19:24 (H) holiness of praise, i.e. a consecrated thing in token of thanksgiving for fruit, offered in 4th year (compare Late Hebrew).
